summary: Defensive rotation drove a razor-thin ASX bounce (XJO +0.18%) as a global tech rout (KOSPI -10%, SoftBank -13%) hammered IT and health care while utilities and staples led. Lithium wipeout continued (PLS, LTR, ELV, CXO all down hard); gold names rallied (SLS +29%). Large-cap XTO held above all MAs while small-cap XSO sits -6.6% below its 200MA. All four indices print 'Bullish' regime labels despite 5day AND 20day downtrends — tape divergence.
